column1: # Ticket 180 seed plus ticket 190 contract coverage. Rows describe only exact
# behaviors covered by the named tests; no row claims family completeness.
# status is one of: missing, vector-only, implemented, verified.
# No row below claims that its instruction family is complete.

column8: notes
Exact reset MSP/PC/xPSR boundary; arithmetic/branch smoke remains combined.
Only the encodings in the named smoke program are covered.
Zero, one, and 31-bit immediate shifts, including LSR/ASR #32 aliases and exact NZC preservation.
Register amounts 0/1/31/32/33/255 with zero/sign/carry boundary vectors.
Register and three-bit immediate forms cover carry, borrow, and signed overflow.
Eight-bit immediate forms cover zero, borrow, and carry without result writes for CMP.
Logical/test forms update N/Z and preserve APSR C/V.
Carry-in, borrow, reverse-subtract, compare, and compare-negative flag vectors.
ROR carry-out and 32-bit multiply wrap with C/V preservation.
Unsupported encoding does not retire or mutate general registers/APSR.
One aligned word transfer; widths, alignment, and faults remain missing.
Deadlocked WFI stop is covered; wake/event variants remain missing.
No retirement and exact unsupported stop are required.
Taken, not-taken, and signed forward/backward displacement bounds are exact.
Zero and nonzero decisions use the bounded forward offset.
High destinations, SP writeback, PC operands, and APSR behavior are covered.
Odd target exchange and BLX Thumb-bit LR semantics are exact.
All one-to-four instruction lengths and T/E inversion are bounded.
Event consumption and deterministic sleep/deadlock are covered.
Privileged I/F/IF enable and disable fields round-trip to masks.
Byte/halfword reversal and signed/unsigned extension are exact.
BKPT retires and records the exact halt stop.
Reserved hints/IT/CPS/reverse/high-register forms, even BX, and UDF fail closed without retirement.
Exact memory-order bytes are 4f ea 0d 00.
Exact decrement-before layout; no family-completeness claim.
Current narrow basic-frame path only.
MSP/PSP selection, eight-word frame layout, stack alignment word, nested handler return, and accepted EXC_RETURN tokens are bounded.
Reserved EXC_RETURN and invalid stacked frames request UsageFault; even handler vectors reach INVSTATE/UsageFault on the next step.
Current level-triggered IRQ path only; priority/nesting remain missing.
One PSP transfer; access-control matrix remains missing.
APSR, xPSR, IPSR, EPSR, MSP, PSP, PRIMASK, BASEPRI, BASEPRI_MAX, FAULTMASK, and CONTROL reads follow privilege and reserved-bit rules.
APSR mask writes, stack-bank updates, PRIMASK, BASEPRI, BASEPRI_MAX, FAULTMASK, and CONTROL writes are bounded and deterministic.
Reserved encodings and invalid register fields refuse atomically; unprivileged special-register writes do not mutate state.
One immediate expansion only.
Raw FPSCR round trip only; FP arithmetic/context remain missing.
One post-indexed word load only.
MOV.W r0,sp, LSL/LSR/ASR/RRX boundaries, and PC/SP restrictions are bounded; exact E-CPU-0001 bytes are retained.
All five logical register operations plus TST/TEQ flag-only aliases and no-S flag preservation are covered.
All five register arithmetic operations plus CMN/CMP aliases cover carry-in, reverse, and no-S flag preservation.
Modified immediate expansion, ORR existing regression, S-bit, and logical/arithmetic immediate paths are bounded.
MOV/MVN immediate aliases and flag/no-flag behavior are covered; reserved second-halfword forms refuse.
MOVW zero-extends, MOVT preserves the lower halfword, and the i-bit immediate split is covered; SP/PC destinations refuse.
12-bit wide arithmetic, legal SP+SP forms, and aligned PC-relative ADR use the architectural PC base.
CLZ zero and nonzero leading-bit behavior is bounded; SP/PC operands refuse.
Bitfield widths one, eight, and maximum are represented; invalid lsb/msb ordering refuses.
Signed and unsigned extraction cover width one, eight, and maximum without signed shifts.
B.W signed negative/positive limits, zero displacement, BL target, and LR Thumb bit are exact.
Reserved immediate, bad PC/SP registers, invalid bitfield ranges, and reserved target forms leave architectural state unchanged.
Reusable fixture reset baseline and no-fault state.
Second halfword outside the mapped RAM is refused without retirement.
One narrow and one wide baseline instruction route through distinct families.
Unsupported encoding retains PC/state and does not retire.
Unmapped data access records the exact failing address.
IRQ level and priority setters ignore index 256.
Two bounded runs compare complete state and selected memory bytes.
All register-offset widths, including LDRSB/LDRSH sign extension, are bounded and deterministic.
Word, halfword, and byte immediate offsets reach the lowest/highest aligned mapped addresses.
Literal PC alignment and word SP-relative store/load are exact.
Address generation and aligned stack-pointer adjustment are bounded.
Exact descending stack layout, ascending pop layout, SP restoration, and Thumb PC exchange.
Low-register lists use ascending addresses and legal writeback.
Unaligned effective addresses and 32-bit address arithmetic overflow refuse without retirement.
Unmapped single and multiple transfers retain the exact failing address and partial store.
Empty lists and even POP targets refuse without SP/PC retirement mutation.
32-bit wrap, accumulate, subtract, and normal CPU MUL routing are bounded; other multiply forms remain explicit refusals.
Signed/unsigned 64-bit results, carry-out, accumulate wrap, and non-overlap constraints are covered.
Signed and unsigned quotients, preserved flags, and divide-by-zero zero result are covered.
Scalar and halfword limits cover min/max behavior and sticky APSR.Q without changing unrelated flags.
Asymmetric Rn/Rm operand order, intermediate double saturation, sticky APSR.Q, flags, and PC retirement are bounded; malformed register forms refuse without mutation.
Signed/unsigned byte, halfword, and exchange forms cover lane results and GE carry/sign patterns.
All four GE selection lanes are covered while unrelated xPSR bits remain unchanged.
LSL packing, ASR #32 alias behavior, and ordinary register overlap boundaries are bounded.
Signed/unsigned halfword, byte, and byte-pair forms cover all four rotations and an overlapping destination.
Reverse, bit-reverse, reverse-shifted halfword, and leading-zero aliases are bounded.
Dual multiply, parallel saturating, bad registers, mismatched aliases, and long-multiply overlap fail closed without mutation.
Word exclusive success, open-monitor failure, same-width matching, and status-register results are bounded.
Byte exclusive load, CLREX invalidation, and failed conditional store are covered.
A successful local STMDB store overlapping the reservation clears the local monitor.
TBB PC update and DMB/DSB/ISB retirement are bounded without host synchronization.
An unmapped later word refuses before the first planned write and preserves SP/memory.
Byte/halfword success, exact-address monitor matching, TBH, malformed forms, and checked address overflow are covered.
Unsigned and signed byte/halfword/word immediate, register-offset, negative-literal, pre-indexed, and unprivileged transfers cover exact values and store addresses.
Malformed fixed bits, invalid PC subword destinations, and base/target writeback overlap refuse without architectural mutation.
Direct family vectors cover ascending and descending addresses, legal writeback, PC exchange, and the PUSH.W/POP.W stack aliases.
Unmapped later stores and base-in-list writeback are refused before register or memory mutation.
